content: He who travels alone at night can boast of being the bravest warrior, but morning light reveals the footprints of the lion.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: It is effortless to boast of our courage and righteousness when operating in the dark where no one can challenge our tales. But the dawn of reality is impartial: it exposes whether we walked with genuine nobility or merely survived through blind luck. Live as if walking in daylight.
practicalInsight: Speak only what can stand the unsparing inspection of the midday sun. Eliminate exaggeration.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you indulging in private boasts that you know the light of honest scrutiny would dismantle?
